During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''battle''' was fought at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Travnin/Legends|Travnin]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. Acting on information that the [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[The Chariot]]'' was faulty&mdash;which meant that the weapons and shields of the vessel could not be fully powered&mdash;the Alliance's [[Cluster Navy]] of nearly one hundred small [[Starship/Legends|starships]] engaged the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in an attempt to destroy it. However, the information was faulty; the original sublight drive was inoperative but a newer one had been secretly installed, allowing the weapons to function. Fortunately for the Alliance, the hull plating removed to install the drive had not been fully replaced, allowing a single ship to attack its weak point and destroy it.
